cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
project(retroHost VERSION 0.1.0)
if(NOT "${IDF_VERSION_MAJOR}.${IDF_VERSION_MINOR}.${IDF_VERSION_PATCH}" STREQUAL "6.0.2")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Use native ESP-IDF 6.0.2 for this project")
endif()
if(NOT IDF_TARGET STREQUAL "esp32s3")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Use idf.py set-target esp32s3")
endif()
#-- littlefs/apple2/system.dsk is NOT generated by the build. Create it by hand, choosing the profile:
#--   python3 tools/createSystemDsk.py --os apple2 --profile PRODOS|PRODOS_640K|PRODOS_800K
if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/littlefs/apple2/system.dsk")
  message(WARNING "littlefs/apple2/system.dsk is missing; run tools/createSystemDsk.py --os apple2 --profile <profile>")
endif()
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/littlefs/apple2/system.dsk")
littlefs_create_partition_image(bootfs littlefs FLASH_IN_PROJECT)
